comment: Carboxyl O-methyltransferase. Methylates the two carboxylic acid groups of 6′,6″-dichloro-chromopyrrolic acid in two sequential steps, via demethyl-lynamicin D, to give lynamicin D. The methyl esters are required for spiro-ring formation in spiroindimicin biosynthesis.

reactions.description: O-methylation of the C-2 carboxylic acid of 6′,6″-dichloro-chromopyrrolic acid to give demethyl-lynamicin D
demethyl-lynamicin D; the product is methylated again at the second carboxylic acid to give lynamicin D
O-methylation of the remaining carboxylic acid of demethyl-lynamicin D to give lynamicin D
lynamicin D is an intermediate in spiroindimicin biosynthesis
